# Module catalog

> Generated by `scripts/docs-generate.ts` from every module descriptor in `modules/`. Do not edit this file. Run `pnpm docs:generate` to update it.

58 modules in the default registry. Each name links to its page, which holds the descriptor facts and the skill text an agent reads. Run `saasaloy add <name> --dry-run` to print what a module writes before it writes anything. The tiers are defined in [the glossary](glossary.md).

## Catalog

| Module | Tier | Stage | What it gives you |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`admin`](modules/admin.md) | capability | mvp | An apps/admin TanStack Router SPA behind the auth session, for the site's staff. |
| [`agent`](modules/agent.md) | capability | mvp | Makes the product usable by AI agents: an OpenAPI document, an MCP server with key sign-in, a Server Card and llms.txt, all built from the route statements. |
| [`ai`](modules/ai.md) | capability | mvp | A packages/ai workspace that hands a feature a LanguageModelV4 from the selected provider, with one model id lookup and one error shape. |
| [`ai-gateway`](modules/ai-gateway.md) | provider | mvp | An ai provider on any OpenAI-compatible gateway (Cloudflare AI Gateway, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway) through @ai-sdk/openai-compatible, with `vendor/model` ids; needs a gateway account and key. |
| [`ai-mock`](modules/ai-mock.md) | provider | mvp | An ai provider whose model echoes the last user message and, on a `/mock` line, streams reasoning, a tool call, a source or a set failure; for local development and tests, with no vendor account. |
| [`api`](modules/api.md) | capability | validate | An apps/api Hono Worker on Cloudflare, registered as the @api alias, with structured logging. |
| [`api-keys`](modules/api-keys.md) | feature | scale | API keys on the Better Auth api-key plugin, stored as a hash; pick api-keys-organization or api-keys-user as the owner. |
| [`api-keys-organization`](modules/api-keys-organization.md) | driver | scale | Organization-owned API keys scoped through can(), on multitenant, plus an API keys admin screen. |
| [`api-keys-user`](modules/api-keys-user.md) | driver | scale | User-owned API keys with their own scopes and rules, for a project with no organizations. |
| [`app`](modules/app.md) | capability | mvp | An apps/app TanStack Router SPA on port 3002 for every signed-in user: the shell frame with the web brand, sign-in and sign-up, and a home screen. |
| [`auth`](modules/auth.md) | capability | mvp | Sign-in and sessions with Better Auth in a packages/auth workspace, on api and database. |
| [`auth-phone`](modules/auth-phone.md) | feature | mvp | Phone number sign-up, sign-in and password reset by SMS code on Better Auth's client instance, with the send log and the number rules. |
| [`ci`](modules/ci.md) | capability | validate | A static GitHub Actions workflow that runs install, ci:prepare, lint, typecheck, test and build on every push to main and every pull request, and turns the deploy CI gate on. |
| [`cms`](modules/cms.md) | feature | scale | An in-house CMS: code-defined collections, a Tiptap editor in apps/admin, drafts, revisions and redirects, and a blog collection. |
| [`command`](modules/command.md) | feature | mvp | A Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette, G-then-letter navigation, a ? shortcut sheet and one conflict-checked key registry for every signed-in SPA on the shell. |
| [`database`](modules/database.md) | capability | validate | A packages/db workspace with Drizzle ORM and drizzle-kit; database-postgres is its driver. |
| [`database-postgres`](modules/database-postgres.md) | driver | validate | The Postgres database driver over postgres.js, with a Hyperdrive-aware getDb and a withDb helper. |
| [`e2e`](modules/e2e.md) | capability | mvp | A packages/e2e workspace with Playwright end-to-end flows that sign in as the seeded admin. |
| [`ecommerce`](modules/ecommerce.md) | feature | money | An in-house shop on Postgres: products with variants, stock holds, carts, orders with a status machine, and flat-rate shipping zones. |
| [`email`](modules/email.md) | capability | mvp | A packages/email workspace with the provider interface, the escaping html tag and safeUrl; add one email provider. |
| [`email-cloudflare`](modules/email-cloudflare.md) | provider | mvp | An email provider on Cloudflare Email Sending, which needs a paid Workers plan and an onboarded domain. |
| [`email-console`](modules/email-console.md) | provider | mvp | An email provider that logs each message instead of sending it, with no plan, domain or key. |
| [`email-plunk`](modules/email-plunk.md) | provider | mvp | An email provider on Plunk over plain HTTP, with no SDK and no binding; needs a Plunk API key. |
| [`email-react`](modules/email-react.md) | feature | mvp | Opt-in JSX email templates on React Email in a packages/email-react workspace, with a preview server. |
| [`env-infisical`](modules/env-infisical.md) | feature | scale | Infisical as a value source for pnpm env:setup and pnpm deploy:production; needs an Infisical account. |
| [`feature-flags`](modules/feature-flags.md) | feature | scale | Typed feature flags with per-tenant overrides, percentage rollouts, kill switches and a flags admin screen. |
| [`file-uploads`](modules/file-uploads.md) | feature | scale | File uploads on storage: the storage_objects table, the /files routes, an upload block and a sweep job. |
| [`infra-ci-deploy`](modules/infra-ci-deploy.md) | feature | validate | A GitHub Actions workflow that runs pnpm deploy:production on every push to main, with the Cloudflare and value-source credentials from repository secrets. |
| [`kv`](modules/kv.md) | capability | scale | A packages/kv workspace with the provider interface, namespaced keys and the consume contract for rate limits. |
| [`kv-cloudflare`](modules/kv-cloudflare.md) | provider | scale | A kv provider on Workers KV, with the KV namespace and ratelimits bindings. |
| [`kv-memory`](modules/kv-memory.md) | provider | scale | A kv provider that keeps entries in memory, for local development and tests. |
| [`kv-upstash`](modules/kv-upstash.md) | provider | scale | A kv provider on Upstash Redis over HTTPS; needs an Upstash account and two REST secrets. |
| [`logger`](modules/logger.md) | capability | validate | A packages/logger workspace with the provider interface, a level threshold and field redaction. |
| [`logger-console`](modules/logger-console.md) | provider | validate | A logger provider that writes structured JSON to the Worker's console. |
| [`multitenant`](modules/multitenant.md) | feature | teams | Tenant isolation with requireTenant(c) and the forTenant(db, tenantId) guard, plus custom roles and a Roles admin screen. |
| [`notification`](modules/notification.md) | feature | mvp | In-app notifications for apps/app: the notifications tables, a notify() helper for api routes, the /notifications routes, category opt-outs and a daily prune. |
| [`payment`](modules/payment.md) | capability | money | One-off payments in a packages/payment workspace: the provider contract, the status machine and staff review routes. |
| [`payment-bkash`](modules/payment-bkash.md) | provider | money | A payment provider on bKash Tokenized Checkout: a hosted bKash page, settled by a status re-read, with refunds. Needs a bKash merchant account. |
| [`payment-console`](modules/payment-console.md) | provider | money | A payment provider with a fake hosted checkout page for development, with no network and no secret. |
| [`payment-manual`](modules/payment-manual.md) | provider | money | A payment provider for bKash, Nagad, Rocket and bank transfers that staff confirm by hand. |
| [`payment-sslcommerz`](modules/payment-sslcommerz.md) | provider | money | A payment provider on the SSLCOMMERZ hosted checkout for cards and wallets in Bangladesh; needs an SSLCOMMERZ store. |
| [`queue`](modules/queue.md) | capability | scale | Background jobs and schedules in a packages/queue workspace, with a cron matcher and the provider registry. |
| [`queue-cloudflare`](modules/queue-cloudflare.md) | provider | scale | A queue provider on Cloudflare Queues, which needs a paid Workers plan. |
| [`queue-memory`](modules/queue-memory.md) | provider | scale | A queue provider that runs jobs in-process, with no binding and no env var. |
| [`ratelimit`](modules/ratelimit.md) | feature | scale | Per-route rate limit middleware with named policies and a 429 carrying Retry-After, on kv. |
| [`shell`](modules/shell.md) | capability | mvp | The frame, primitives and blocks every signed-in SPA renders: layout, nav, user menu, theme toggle, data table and the coss primitive set under @repo/ui/*/shell. |
| [`sms`](modules/sms.md) | capability | scale | A packages/sms workspace with the provider interface and segment counting; add one sms provider. |
| [`sms-console`](modules/sms-console.md) | provider | scale | An sms provider that logs each message instead of sending it. |
| [`sms-khudebarta`](modules/sms-khudebarta.md) | provider | scale | An sms provider on the Khudebarta gateway for Bangladeshi numbers; needs a Khudebarta account. |
| [`storage`](modules/storage.md) | capability | scale | File storage in a packages/storage workspace: the provider interface, signed links and an api proxy route. |
| [`storage-cloudflare`](modules/storage-cloudflare.md) | provider | scale | A storage provider on Cloudflare R2, with the BUCKET binding and signed URLs. |
| [`storage-memory`](modules/storage-memory.md) | provider | scale | A storage provider that keeps objects in memory, for local development and tests. |
| [`subscription`](modules/subscription.md) | capability | money | Subscriptions in a packages/subscription workspace: the provider contract, plans.ts, the subscription projection and the plan entitlements. |
| [`subscription-console`](modules/subscription-console.md) | provider | money | A subscription provider that runs the whole checkout flow with no network and no secret. |
| [`subscription-stripe`](modules/subscription-stripe.md) | provider | money | A subscription provider on Stripe through stripe and @better-auth/stripe; needs a Stripe account. |
| [`teams`](modules/teams.md) | feature | teams | Organizations, memberships, roles and copy-ID invitations on Better Auth, plus a site-admin Teams screen. |
| [`validators`](modules/validators.md) | capability | validate | A packages/validators workspace with the zod request schemas and the shared error envelope. |
| [`waitlist`](modules/waitlist.md) | feature | validate | A waitlist form on the landing page, with its API route and table, to collect early sign-ups. |
